description: List voice memos from Apple Voice Memos app with metadata. Returns memo IDs, titles, dates, durations, and whether they have transcripts.

limit.description: Maximum number of memos to return (1-100, default: 50)

offset.description: Number of memos to skip for pagination (default: 0)

search.description: Search term to filter memos by title or custom label

name: list_voice_memos
